author: harness:claude-code

patch.value: Model capture is inert in practice: zero of 35,103 recorded entries carry a model, because the declared signal for the primary harness is an environment variable that harness does not set

The recorded entry format carries agent_model and agent_model_source, the detection layer resolves a model candidate, and history writes the field when a candidate exists. All of that shipped. What did not ship is a working signal for the harness that actually drives this repository. The built-in descriptor for claude-code declares model_environment_keys of ANTHROPIC_MODEL and CLAUDE_MODEL. Neither is present in a live Claude Code session; the environment exposes CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT, CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH, CLAUDE_PID and CLAUDE_EFFORT, and no model variable at all. The consequence is measurable rather than theoretical: scanning all 2,085 history streams and 35,103 recorded entries in this workspace returns zero entries carrying agent_model. Harness detection itself works correctly and is recorded on every entry as detected. So the capability reads as delivered on every surface — the type declares it, the detector resolves it, the writer persists it — and produces nothing, and no gate or check notices. Per-model attribution analytics, which depend entirely on this field, would return empty results that are indistinguishable from a fleet in which every agent happens to be unattributed.

The declared signals for each supported harness are validated against what that harness actually exposes, and a signal that cannot fire is either corrected or recorded as unavailable rather than left declared; For harnesses that expose no model variable, an alternative resolution path is defined — client handshake metadata, invocation argument, or explicit configuration — so the field can be populated without the agent naming itself; A check reports the proportion of recorded entries carrying a model, per harness, so an inert signal is visible instead of silent; The check fails when a harness that declares a model signal records no model across a window of mutations, which is the condition that exists today; Model capture is exercised end to end for at least one harness in the test suite, asserting the recorded entry rather than the detector's return value; Documentation states which harnesses currently yield a model and which do not, so the analytics that consume it can distinguish absent from unattributed
Make the recorded model a fact that is either present or explicitly known to be unavailable, never silently missing

Recording which model acted is a stated requirement for this tracker, and the mechanism has been treated as delivered since it shipped. It has never once produced a value. Everything built on per-model attribution is currently building on an empty column.
Turns model provenance from a declared capability into a measured one, and unblocks per-model attribution analytics which cannot function without it
Recorded entries carry the acting model wherever the harness can supply it, and the coverage is reported rather than assumed
Every mutation written while the signal is inert is a permanently unattributable entry, and this workspace has already written 35,103 of them

message: File inert model capture: 0 of 35,103 entries carry agent_model; claude-code descriptor declares ANTHROPIC_MODEL/CLAUDE_MODEL, neither of which the harness sets
